name: Northwest Gourmet Foods
old_description: Northwest Gourmet Foods produces fine dressings, sauces, mayonnaise and soups for food service, retail, and private-label clients.
about:
Northwest Gourmet Foods operates from Renton, Washington, where it was founded in 1986. The company manufactures salad dressings, sauces, mayonnaise, and soups for food-service, retail, and private-label customers across the Pacific Northwest.

Its production lines handle fresh, refrigerated, shelf-stable, and cooked hot-filled products, with packaging options ranging from 3/4-ounce portion cups to 320-gallon totes. An in-house research and development team creates custom formulations for both retail and food-service clients, while the company emphasizes highly efficient manufacturing and packaging processes.

The customer base includes food-service distributors, grocery retailers, and brands seeking private-label partners. The company positions itself as an industry leader in the Pacific Northwest, delivering competitively priced quality food products for more than two decades.

Northwest Gourmet Foods differentiates itself through flexible packaging scalability, custom formulation capabilities, and a focus on high-quality ingredients across its product categories.
